title: jointly trained quadratic Bezier surface chart
hypothesis: Joint training of a 3x3 quadratic Bezier surface of MLP weights can yield accurate classifiers for heldout mixtures across four rotated Digits domains, using less serialized storage than materializing a 5x5 grid of surface views.
physical_object: Nine MLP control-point state dictionaries for a tensor-product quadratic Bezier surface
mirror_coordinate: Two normalized coordinates (u,v), or m=(2u-1,2v-1) with inverse decoder u=(m0+1)/2, v=(m1+1)/2
logical_multiplicity: Twenty-five evaluated classifiers on a fixed 5x5 coordinate grid; count as views, not independent capacities
controls: single pooled standard MLP trained on uniform four-domain mixtures
uniform model soup of four independent MLPs
bilinear interpolation of four independently trained corner models

development.selection_metric: mean validation NLL over the 5x5 coordinate grid; learning rate selected from .03 and .1

data.split: fixed stratified source-image 60/20/20; train_test_split seeds 420 and 421

training.surface: tensor-product degree-2 Bernstein basis over 3x3 learned weight control points
training.optimizer: SGD momentum .9, weight_decay 1e-4, cosine learning-rate schedule
training.coordinate_sampling: uniform independent u,v on [0,1]; each minibatch uses bilinear corner-domain mixture weights ((1-u)(1-v), u(1-v), (1-u)v, uv); all 9 control models are combined by quadratic Bernstein coefficients for forward/backward

evaluation.coordinate_grid: 25 points on 5x5 uniform grid, endpoints and interior included
evaluation.metric: accuracy and NLL against heldout digit labels on each coordinate's matching bilinear four-domain mixture
evaluation.fresh_seed_meaning: initialization/data-order replicates on one fixed split; not unseen-task generalization

paid_objects: all nine control point state dictionaries
storage.coordinate_encoding: two float32 values per coordinate; Mirror code is same width

report: control blending MAC proxy per coordinate
heldout query MACs across all views

success_gate: Every fresh run: worst-grid accuracy within 2 percentage points of paired pooled standard model; all four corner accuracies at least 90%; 9-control-point payload smaller than 25 materialized views; Mirror decoder max absolute logit difference <=5e-6.
failure_gate: Any quality gate miss fails the quality frontier; a native-coordinate alias or control-point payload that does not improve relevant quality/storage controls fails Mirror-specific attribution. Report each axis separately.
boundaries: Four image rotation domains are a narrow synthetic domain-mixture screen; no language-model, natural multi-task, or unseen-domain claim.
All nine surface control points are fully charged; no learned control point is free.
Surface coordinates and 25 sampled views do not imply independent capacity.
A tensor-product quadratic Bezier surface is a deliberately small screen, not a reproduction of every PA232 model or optimizer detail.
